hero.title: Your roadmap is a guess.
hero.sub: An MCP server that hands your agents verified customer outcomes — and the evidence behind them.

problem.title: Opinion is expensive.

beats.quote: Roadmaps set by whoever talks loudest.
beats.support: Decisions default to seniority, not evidence.

beats.quote: Features for customers who never asked.
beats.support: Nobody validated the outcome; only the idea.

beats.quote: Agents fluent in everything, grounded in nothing.
beats.support: A model will confidently invent your customer.

problem.closer: Add it up and the roadmap isn't a plan. It's a guess.

insight.title: Ask for outcomes, not opinions.
paragraphs: Outcome-Driven Innovation asks customers how much each desired outcome matters and how satisfied they are with it today.
The gap between importance and satisfaction is where products win or die.
Agentic ODI stores those outcomes, scores them, and serves them to any agent over MCP.
